## Structural Criteria

<!-- Transcribed from Tier 1 of agent-checklist.md. One EVAL-Sxx per row. -->

- [ ] **EVAL-S01:** Agent file exists
  - **Test:** Verify: `.md` file is present in `src/agents/<domain>/` and non-empty
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold

- [ ] **EVAL-S02:** Frontmatter complete
  - **Test:** Verify: `name`, `description`, `domain`, `role` all present
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold

- [ ] **EVAL-S03:** `domain` in AGENT_TAXONOMY.md
  - **Test:** Verify: Value matches a row in AGENT_TAXONOMY.md
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold

- [ ] **EVAL-S04:** `role` in AGENT_TAXONOMY.md
  - **Test:** Verify: Value matches a row in AGENT_TAXONOMY.md
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold

- [ ] **EVAL-S05:** `tags` well-formed
  - **Test:** Verify: Array of lowercase hyphenated strings
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold

- [ ] **EVAL-S06:** Name follows convention
  - **Test:** Verify: `<domain>-<concern>-<role>` pattern (e.g., `synapse-skill-eval-judge`)
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold

- [ ] **EVAL-S07:** Name globally unique
  - **Test:** Verify: No collision in AGENTS_REGISTRY.md
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold

- [ ] **EVAL-S08:** Listed in AGENTS_REGISTRY.md
  - **Test:** Verify: Row exists with correct description and consumer list
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold

- [ ] **EVAL-S09:** Domain README has row
  - **Test:** Verify: Domain `README.md` contains a row linking this agent
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold

## Quality Criteria

<!-- Transcribed from Tier 2 of agent-checklist.md. One EVAL-Qxx per row. -->

- [ ] **EVAL-Q01:** Clear persona
  - **Test:** Verify: Opening paragraph describes the agent's role and mindset
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold

- [ ] **EVAL-Q02:** Instructions trace to failure modes
  - **Test:** Verify: Each instruction implies "without this, the agent does X which causes Y"
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold

- [ ] **EVAL-Q03:** Under 300 lines
  - **Test:** Verify: Line count ≤ 300
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold

- [ ] **EVAL-Q04:** Consumer skills identified
  - **Test:** Verify: At least one skill is named that dispatches this agent
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold

- [ ] **EVAL-Q05:** No user-facing language
  - **Test:** Verify: No slash commands, no "the user can...", no interactive prompts — agents are never user-invocable
  - **Fail signal:** Pass condition does not hold
